sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain strong leaders and will be heavy favourites against Alsager, who sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and are winless in their last five matches.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to close the gap on leaders Sandbach after their own recent loss. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth travel to Eccleshall in an intriguing mid-table clash between two in-form sides. Wolverhampton Casuals, fifth and on a three-game winning streak, visit Wednesfield Community at home in a Saturday fixture. Bilston Town (6th) entertain Foley Meir in a contest between mid-table teams, while Barnton host Shawbury United—the latter deeply struggling with six consecutive defeats. Market Drayton Town face New Mills away, both sides seeking consistency after mixed recent form. Brereton Social host Widnes Town on Saturday; Widnes remain winless and bottom of the basement with just 2 points from 7 games. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a battle between two of the division's weakest-performing clubs. Crewe entertain Allscott Heath in another lower-table fixture. Midweek, Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community on Wednesday 7 October at 19:45 in a rearranged fixture.
